products.product_description: The radiance lives on in the Nike Air Force 1 '07, the b-ball icon that puts a fresh spin on what you know best: crisp leather, bold colours and the perfect amount of flash to make you shine.
Lace up and feel the legacy. Produced at the intersection of art, music and culture, this champion running shoe helped define the '90s.
Created for the hardwood but taken to the streets, the '80s b-ball icon returns with perfectly shined overlays and classic team colours.
